content.title: Block unauthenticated access to the funding operation
content.intent: Prove that a user without an authenticated session cannot use protected balance-increase functionality as an authenticated user.
content.technique_notes: Applied auth/permission technique for the protected-operation boundary and negative/error technique for the blocked unauthenticated path. Auth-gated profile applied. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because auth applies; no covering array was needed because this path exercises one representative unauthenticated state against one protected operation. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.

parameters.operation: deposit, add-funds, or equivalent balance-increase action if exposed after login
